page.notes: Scan shows two printed pages, and the left page's number is not visible. Many marginal items were not clearly separable, so the column split on the right page is uncertain, and I have followed the visible line order. Several entries (e.g. "Antonij Mollinij", "Antonius Monachus") and a number of names and titles are uncertain and may need checking against the original. Page-number line numbers 10–60 are gutter line markers, not text. The catchword and signature are not clearly visible and are marked as illegible.
